name: BDMergeFroxelTemporal

When OFF: no jitter, no resolve, and the integrate pass reads the raw injected light atlas directly = exactly the F2 look (slightly steppier but identical layout). Only active when BDMergeFroxelVolumetrics and BDMergeFroxelLights are on.

The neighborhood clamp bounds it so it cannot smear. Only active when BDMergeFroxelVolumetrics, BDMergeFroxelLights and BDMergeFroxelTemporal are on.

name: RenderAreaShadowBudget
saved_in_scenes: unknown; structured blocks/dynamic ownership require review
comment: Hard area-shadow march budget in millions/frame (1-1500). Each draw is limited to half. Runtime reductions, in order: resolution, rays (down to 8), steps, rays (down to the floor of 4), steps (down to 8; with Thin objects on only the far steps thin, every preset shares that floor), then the least important lights lose their soft shadow (never fewer rays). With Thin objects on, the lights that the budget cannot cover at Thin quality keep exactly the regular march they get with it off (the most important lights get the Thin march with what is left; Thin never admits fewer lights than off), and while VCam soft shadows are on, the main view leaves what the camera feeds that are live that frame can spend (each live feed gets exactly the budget share, and the lights, it gets with Thin objects off), so turning a feed on can lower the main view's Thin quality; with no live feed the main view has the whole budget. The Thin lights of a mixed plan march the same ray count as the regular ones, so only their steps differ. The regular march itself changed in this version: it now also drops to half resolution before it loses rays, and holds the floors above.
